mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to tightened discount rates affecting expected cash flows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or at least not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) coincides with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as strong hiring signals corporate optimism and future earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during the labor expansion trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST (industrial production) below the prior two months' levels predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as weak demand reduces corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during the detected decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO (industrial production index) below 100 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over 20 days as market anticipates supply-side constraints and price adjustments.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during the supply shock signal.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a positive 20-day forward return as lower labor costs are interpreted as a tailwind for corporate profitability.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5 and UNRATE < UNRATE_t-1 and UNRATE < UNRATE_t-2
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive or are not statistically significant (p >= 0.05) during the unemployment rate decline.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both GDPC1 (consumer demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) above their 12-month averages predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as dual demand signals boost earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the dual demand acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in CPIAUCSL (CPI) above 237.8 (current August level) followed by a sustained increase over the next month predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over 5 days due to inflation fears eroding equity valuations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or not significantly different from zero (p > 0.05) during the inflation spike.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of HOUST (industrial production) falls below 1100, the S&P 500 exhibits a negative 20-day forward return as market anticipates production shortfalls and supply disruptions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the supply contraction signal.
